name: Tesseract Descartes Profile
description: Build an exact native ProfileDictionary exposing every released Descartes pipeline-profile control.

inputParameters.name: profile_names
inputParameters.description: Optional exact profile names to register. Unconnected preserves Tesseract's native name set.

inputParameters.name: enable_collision
inputParameters.description: Optional vertex collision-check flag. Unconnected preserves the native default (enabled in 0.35.0.6).

inputParameters.name: enable_edge_collision
inputParameters.description: Optional edge collision-check flag. Unconnected preserves the native default (disabled in 0.35.0.6).

inputParameters.name: num_threads
inputParameters.description: Optional positive native ladder-graph solver thread count. Unconnected lets Tesseract choose.

inputParameters.name: sample_axis
inputParameters.description: Optional finite non-degenerate tool-local axis [x, y, z] for rotational sampling.

inputParameters.name: sample_resolution
inputParameters.description: Optional positive tool-axis sampling step in radians.

inputParameters.name: sample_min
inputParameters.description: Optional finite start of the tool-axis sampling range in radians.

inputParameters.name: sample_max
inputParameters.description: Optional finite end of the tool-axis sampling range in radians.

inputParameters.name: ik_solver
inputParameters.description: Optional exact native IK solver name used while sampling waypoints.

inputParameters.name: use_redundant_joint_solutions
inputParameters.description: Optional native redundant-joint-solution flag. Unconnected preserves the native default (disabled in 0.35.0.6).

inputParameters.name: move_profile
inputParameters.description: Optional exact native DescartesMoveProfileD full override. It cannot be combined with move-profile convenience controls.

outputParameters.name: profiles
outputParameters.description: Exact native Tesseract ProfileDictionary for DescartesF/DescartesD pipeline variants.
